ability_translation.status: Conditional arithmetic, not a full character-sheet prediction or mechanics certification
ability_translation.modifierCasesApplyOnlyIf: No pre-existing same-type source masks any changed Wisdom gear bucket. These are illustrative full-gear-delta cases, not the default live-character prediction.
ability_translation.fullStackRule: For each changed ability bonus type t with other applicable source B_t, whole-score change is sum_t(max(newGear_t,B_t)-max(oldGear_t,B_t)). Then apply floor((newWholeScore-10)/2)-floor((oldWholeScore-10)/2). Do not substitute the raw gear-subtotal delta if another source overlaps.
ability_translation.wisdomEnhancementExample: When the only change is Enhancement Wisdom0→15, let E be the already applicable nongear Enhancement Wisdom: actual score increase=max(15,E)-E. It can be smaller than15 or zero.
assumptions: Same nongear ability contributions, skill ranks and buffs in both cases, but their existing same-type overlap must still be accounted for.
Wisdom remains the governing ability for Spot and Will; no alternate-stat rule is supplied.
No item-dependent nongear buff difference, dispel or conditional downtime is inferred.
ability_translation.missing: Actual pre-swap total Wisdom, its parity, and overlapping typed buffs are unknown. The guide starting Wisdom8 is not a complete level36 sheet.
ability_translation.reflex: The selected guide has Insightful Reflexes. Preservation is conditional on Intelligence governing Reflex in both kits, as intended by this INT-based guide, and on unchanged nongear contributions. Gear-only INT totals do not establish the full character INT-versus-DEX relationship.
ability_translation.dexterity: Balance, Hide, Move Silently, Open Lock and Tumble may lose ability-derived contribution after full same-type-stack reconciliation. AC impact also depends on armor maximum-Dexterity allowance and the full sheet; neither raw gear loss nor modifier loss is automatically final AC loss.
